name: tr.com.minikgunluk/minikgunluk
title: Minik Günlük
description: Turkish parenting guides (ages 0-6), videos for parents and Minik Günlük app info. Read-only.

tools.name: search_parent_guides
tools.description: Search Minik Günlük's free parenting guides (in Turkish) for children aged 0-6: nursery/kindergarten adjustment, sleep, eating, toilet training, tantrums, screen time, going to school when sick, medicine safety at home, play, sibling jealousy, talking with the teacher. Returns title, summary, category, age range, reading time, article URL and up to 3 practical tips. Call with no arguments to list the latest guides. Always show the article URL to the user. Guides are general information, not medical advice. TR: Okul öncesi çocuk ebeveyn rehberi makalelerinde arar; ör. query "kreşe uyum", "uyku düzeni", "tuvalet eğitimi", "öfke nöbeti", "ekran süresi", "ateşli çocuk okula gider mi", "kardeş kıskançlığı".

query.description: Keywords in Turkish or English, e.g. "uyku", "tantrum", "tuvalet eğitimi". Optional. / Anahtar kelime (isteğe bağlı).

category.description: Optional category filter as published on the site (e.g. "Uyku", "Beslenme", "Okula uyum"). / İsteğe bağlı kategori.

tools.name: get_parent_guide
tools.description: Get the full text of one Minik Günlük parenting guide by its slug (from search_parent_guides) or its minikgunluk.com.tr/rehber URL: all sections, tips, FAQ, sources and the article URL. Summarize for the user and always include the article URL. Do not add diagnoses, doses or treatments; suggest consulting a pediatrician. TR: Rehber makalesinin tamamı (bölümler, ipuçları, sık sorulan sorular, kaynaklar).

slug.description: Guide slug or URL, e.g. "krese-uyum" or "https://minikgunluk.com.tr/rehber/krese-uyum". / Makale kısa adı ya da adresi.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List short Minik Günlük videos (Turkish): videos for parents on the Minik TV parents page (https://minikgunluk.com.tr/minik-tv/veliler, e.g. nursery adjustment, sleep, screen time, medicine tracking) and app introduction videos. Returns title, description, page URL (and MP4 URL where available). Optional keyword filter. Always show the page URL. TR: Veliler için kısa videolar ve uygulama tanıtım videoları; ör. query "uyku", "ilaç", "kreşe uyum".

query.description: Optional keyword. / İsteğe bağlı anahtar kelime.

topic.description: Same as query (kept for compatibility). / query ile aynı.

tools.name: get_app_info
tools.description: What the Minik Günlük app is (school-family app for nurseries and preschools: daily meals, sleep, toilet, mood, activity photos, medicine tracking at school and home, messages, appointments and video calls with the teacher), App Store / Google Play links and the demo request page for schools (https://minikgunluk.com.tr/demo). Contains no prices: for pricing, point schools to the demo page. TR: Minik Günlük uygulaması nedir, nereden indirilir, okullar için tanıtım/demo. Fiyat bilgisi yok.
